mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Adds an email contact to a specific SendPulse mailing list (address book), optionally attaching subscriber variables (e.g. name, phone) and numeric tag IDs. Use to enroll a new contact into a list; requires the target mailing list ID and a valid email. Not idempotent — each call re-submits the contact to the list.

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Sets a single named variable (custom field) to a given value for one subscriber, identified by email, within a specific SendPulse mailing list. Use to overwrite a single field value; the variable must already exist on the list and its type (number/date) is validated against the value. Idempotent — repeating with the same value leaves the field unchanged.

delete-contact.name: delete-contact
delete-contact.description: Permanently delete contact from all mailing lists

email.description: Email address to delete from all mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes a contact, identified by email, from every SendPulse mailing list (address book) in the account at once. Use to fully purge a contact rather than unsubscribe from a single list. Destructive but idempotent — once deleted, repeating the call leaves the contact absent.

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Unsubscribes one or more email addresses (up to 100 per call) from a single specified SendPulse mailing list, leaving them in other lists. Use to opt contacts out of one list rather than purge them account-wide. Idempotent — repeating leaves the same contacts unsubscribed from that list.

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

email.description: Email address of the subscriber to update

variables.description: Subscriber variables to update (e.g., name, custom fields)

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing subscriber, identified by email, within a specific SendPulse mailing list by setting their phone number and/or one or more variables (custom fields) to new values. Use to overwrite a contact's details; at least one of phone or variables must be supplied. Idempotent — repeating with the same values leaves the contact unchanged.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_subscriber.name: new_subscriber
new_subscriber.description: Fires when new subscriber is added

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new email contact is added to the selected SendPulse mailing list (address book), via any source such as a subscription form or import. Each event represents one newly added subscriber and includes their email, source, and variables.

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a contact unsubscribes from the selected SendPulse mailing list (address book). Each event represents one unsubscribe and includes the email, the reason if provided, and whether they opted out of all lists.

mailingListId.description: Select one of your SendPulse mailing lists

aiMetadata.description: Polls the selected SendPulse mailing list (address book) and fires when an existing subscriber's details or variables change between checks. Each event represents one changed contact and includes the previous data, current data, and a diff of the changed fields.
